name: Viking Therapeutics, Inc.
summary: Viking Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, focuses on the development of novel therapies for metabolic and endocrine disorders. Its lead drug candidate is VK2809, an orally available tissue and receptor-subtype selective agonist of the thyroid hormone receptor beta (TRß), which is in Phase IIb clinical trials to treat patients with biopsy-confirmed non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, as well as NAFLD. The company develops VK5211, an orally available non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator that is in Phase II clinical trials for the treatment of patients recovering from non-elective hip fracture surgery; VK0612, which is in Phase II clinical trials for metabolic disorders and anemia; VK2735, a novel dual agonist of the glucagon-like peptide 1, which is in Phase 1 SAD/MAD clinical trial, and VK0214, an orally available tissue and receptor-subtype selective agonist of the TRß for X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.
leadership_credibility: Led by Dr. Brian Lian Ph.D. (President, CEO & Director). Directing strategic execution, operational scaling, and capital allocation for Viking Therapeutics, Inc..
insider_alignment: Management and board maintain substantial equity alignment; institutional ownership exceeds 70%. High analyst backing (19 Strong Buy ratings).
moat_type: Proprietary Dual GLP-1/GIP Agonist Patents, Superior Tolerability Profile, Subcutaneous + Oral Formulation Pipeline
moat_durability: High barrier to entry in metabolic disease therapeutics; oral formulation offers multi-billion dollar convenience edge over daily/weekly injectables.
moat_intangibles: Proprietary dual incretin peptide IP, oral tablet lipid formulation patents, and clinical trial trial safety superiority data.
moat_network_effects: High regulatory and patent barriers to entry: multi-year clinical trial requirements and strict FDA manufacturing standards.
moat_pricing_power: Scale & Volume Cost Advantage: Operating margins supported by high-volume throughput and lean unit cost structure (0.0% gross margin).
tam_description: Global obesity, type 2 diabetes, and NASH/MASH metabolic therapeutics projected to exceed $180 Billion+ by 2032.
tam_sanity_check: Pipeline Stage: Capturing even 5-10% of the $180B metabolic therapeutics market represents $9B - $18B in peak annual blockbuster sales.
tam_optionality: Oral formulation compliance advantages, non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (VK2809 Phase 2b), and potential big pharma buyout.
